subject: Admin Seed Sprint: Customer kickoff & API key bootstrap for Solstice Health
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@solsticehealth.com>, Solstice Health Onboarding <onboarding@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin Seed Sprint: Customer kickoff & API key bootstrap for Solstice Health

Hi Laura / Solstice onboarding team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Per our kickoff, we want to get the initial tenant seeded with admin users, a couple of project namespaces, and API key skeletons so your engineers can start smoke-testing the integration this week. Proposed short plan below (30–45m of work from your side up front):

- Confirm 2–3 admin accounts (names + emails) we should invite as workspace admins.
- Decide whether you want SSO-first (we'll delay long-lived API keys) or API-keys-first (we seed keys into a secure vault and rotate after SSO).
- Provide desired project namespace names (we'll create projects and seed role bindings).
- Accept invite links we send from the console.

Attachments: I attached a lightweight "admin matrix" and an API-key template for your convenience.

Goal for this week: basic admin invites + one project with seeded API keys for dev testing.

Can you confirm admin emails and your preferred path (SSO-first vs API-keys-first) by EOD today? If SSO-first, please share your Okta IdP team contact and a rough ETA for a metadata exchange.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Monica and Dev for the seeding work once we have your direction.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager 
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: solstice_mvp_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34KB); api-key-template.csv (csv, 2KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@solsticehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@solsticehealth.com>, Solstice Health Onboarding <onboarding@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 14:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin Seed Sprint: Customer kickoff & API key bootstrap for Solstice Health

Stephanie — thanks for the clear plan. We prefer an SSO-first approach so we don't have long-lived keys floating around while internal IAM is settled. Quick answers:

- Admins to invite: Laura Chen (laura.chen@solsticehealth.com), Rajiv Patel (rajiv@solsticehealth.com), and Priya Suresh (priya.s@solsticehealth.com). I attached a CSV with these for convenience.
- Okta contact: Tom Wallace (tom.wallace@solsticehealth.com) — he's ready to do the metadata exchange.
- Project namespaces: solstice-dev, solstice-staging. We'll create prod after we validate dev/staging.

SSO timeline: Tom says the initial SAML config can be ready by Wednesday morning PT. If that holds, let's schedule the SSO handoff + test for Wed 9:00am PT. Once SSO is active we can proceed to rotating in short-lived API keys for CI.

On the API-keys-first option: we can revisit if SSO slips, but prefer SSO-first for security.

Thanks — Laura

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 14:18:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin Seed Sprint: Customer kickoff & API key bootstrap for Solstice Health

Team — quick internal note after Laura's response. SSO-first is preferred by the customer, so here's a suggested minimal plan to keep momentum while SAML is being exchanged:

1) Wednesday 09:00 PT: SSO metadata handshake + test (Stephanie / Tom / Dev) — owner: Dev Patel.
2) Wednesday 11:00 PT: Console invites sent to Laura, Rajiv, Priya once SSO validated (owner: Stephanie).
3) Thursday: Create solstice-dev and solstice-staging projects and pre-configure role bindings for Admin/Engineer/Observer (owner: Monica).
4) Friday: If SSO stable, seed short-lived API keys for CI in Vault and document rotation (owner: Dev).

Risks / notes:
- If Tom can't complete metadata by Wed morning, fallback to seeding keys for an isolated dev project with strict rotation and audit enabled.
- We should create a temporary support Slack channel and add the customer's IdP engineer.

I'll add these items to the onboarding checklist in the shared Drive and create calendar invites. Stephanie, can you confirm you can run the Wed 9am PT call?

—Monica

Monica Patel
Senior Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 15:05:10 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Admin Seed Sprint: project names + API key template

Forwarding technical notes and the API key template. Quick summary and asks from engineering: 

- We recommend project naming: solstice-dev, solstice-staging, solstice-prod (reserve prod until signoff).
- For now we'll avoid seeding long-lived keys. If we do a temporary key fallback, we'll place keys in the Redwood customer vault and map to a CI service account with scope limited to the dev project. Keys will be rotated after SSO is live.
- Please confirm exact project display names and any special tags (e.g., org:healthcare, env:pii-prod) so we can set RBAC and audit filters correctly.

Attachment: api-key-template.csv (csv, 2KB) — template includes columns: project, service_account, scope, initial_ttl_days (we suggest 7).

Schedule: I can run the SSO test Wed 9am PT. Stephanie — please send calendar invite with Tom's dial-in and add the temporary Slack channel when created.

--
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@solsticehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin Seed Sprint: Customer kickoff & API key bootstrap for Solstice Health

Thanks, all — confirmed on our side. Tom (Okta) is on the Wed 9:00am PT call and I've added Priya and Rajiv to the calendar invite. We will not require prod until later; dev and staging are fine.

Action items we completed this morning:
- Confirmed admin list (Laura, Rajiv, Priya) — please send invites.
- Okta contact: Tom Wallace (tom.wallace@solsticehealth.com) — he will share SAML metadata pre-call.
- Project names: solstice-dev, solstice-staging (agreed).

We attached the signed SoW to the shared Drive (link in calendar) and uploaded the small admin CSV earlier. Looking forward to Wednesday.

Best,
Laura
Customer Success Manager
Solstice Health
laura.chen@solsticehealth.com
